summary: Corporación América Airports S.A. filed a Form 6-K on April 21, 2026, furnishing a press release reporting March 2026 passenger traffic. The release details a 5.5% year-over-year increase in total passenger traffic, with international traffic up 12.2% and domestic down 2.4%. No corporate event, transaction, or restructuring is announced; this is a routine operational update. As a foreign private issuer filing under Rule 13a-16, this 6-K serves as an equivalent to a domestic issuer's press release of monthly operating data.
